reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: There's a lot to be written in this lady's career, for sure,
foreground_english.zh: 她的职业生涯，还有很多篇章要写，

foreground_english.en: if she can continue to improve, stay focused,
foreground_english.zh: 只要她继续进步、保持专注，

foreground_english.en: and more important than just about anything else is to enjoy the journey,
foreground_english.zh: 更重要的是，享受这段旅程，

foreground_english.en: enjoy the ups, enjoy the downs,
because there's going to be plenty of them along the way.
foreground_english.zh: 因为一路上，这样的起落会有很多。

review_note: 同一条：颁奖与捧杯（368–386）时的解说。两档逐词一致（medium 368.70–385.80；small 368.60–385.80）。段首 368.2 在 Forever.（两档都有，366.34/367.12）之后，段尾 386.3 在温网片尾板（388 秒起）之前。
